answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a ridge as the anchor of the cost. A bridge stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a hollow holds the reputation...
